examples.text: sā sāṇipākāraṃ parikkhipāpetvā antosāṇiyaṃ tassā hattha-pāda-nābhi-udara-pariyosānāni oloketvā māsadivase samānetvā, gihibhāve imāya gabbho laddho'ti ñatvā, therassa tam'atthaṃ ārocesi. ath'assā thero parisamajjhe parisuddhabhāvaṃ patiṭṭhāpesi.

44102.meaning1: massages all over; completely caresses; fondles; rubs every part

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavato pādāni mukhena ca paricumbati, pāṇīhi ca parisambāhati, nāmañ'ca sāveti

44104.meaning1: who purifies a group; who makes an assembly shine

examples.text: katame cattāro? bhikkhu, bhikkhave, sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo parisasobhano, bhikkhunī, bhikkhave, sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā parisasobhanā, upāsako, bhikkhave, sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo parisasobhano, upāsikā, bhikkhave, sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā parisasobhanā. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro parisasobhanā'ti.

44106.meaning1: overcomes; overwhelms; overpowers; gets the better of
44106.synonym: ajjhottharati, addhabhāveti, pariyādiyati, pasahati, bhunāti, sahati
44106.commentary: (SNa) ativiya maṃ tasmiṃ samaye lobhadhammā parisahantī'ti maṃ tasmiṃ samaye atikkamitvā lobho adhibhavatī'ti attho. (NIDD1a) sahantī'ti maddanti ghaṭṭanaṃ uppādenti.

examples.text: aham'pi kho, bho bhāradvāja, yasmiṃ samaye arakkhiten'eva kāyena, arakkhitāya vācāya, arakkhitena cittena, anupaṭṭhitāya satiyā, asaṃvutehi indriyehi antepuraṃ pavisāmi, ativiya maṃ tasmiṃ samaye lobhadhammā parisahanti.
te kilesā taṃ puggalaṃ sahanti parisahanti abhibhavanti ajjhottharanti pariyādiyanti maddantī'ti, evam'pi abalā naṃ balīyantī'ti.
so ārāmagato parisati dhammaṃ deseti, na taṃ parisaṃ ussādeti, na taṃ parisaṃ apasādeti, añña'd'atthu dhammiyā kathāya taṃ parisaṃ sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
te vādakāmā parisaṃ vigayha, bālaṃ dahantī mithu aññam'aññaṃ, vadanti te aññasitā kath'ojjaṃ, pasaṃsakāmā kusalā vadānā.
bhikkhū'pi āyasmantaṃ vakkhanti sahadhammena, evaṃ saṃvaddhā hi tassa bhagavato parisā yadidaṃ aññam'aññavacanena aññam'aññavuṭṭhāpanenā'ti
ajjhāvar'amhā nandassa, bhoto santikam'āgatā, suṇātu me bhavaṃ vacanaṃ, nandassa parisāya ca.

44110.meaning1: gathering of the dregs; assembly of rubbish

examples.text: parisākasaṭo ca parisāmaṇḍo ca. katamo ca, bhikkhave, parisākasaṭo? idha, bhikkhave, yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū chand'āgatiṃ gacchanti, dos'āgatiṃ gacchanti, moh'āgatiṃ gacchanti, bhay'āgatiṃ gacchanti.

kathañ'ca, gahapatayo, catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti? idha, gahapatayo, ekacco musāvādī hoti. sabhāgato vā parisāgato vā, ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā, abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho, eh'ambho purisa, yaṃ jānāsi taṃ vadehī'ti

44112.meaning1: gathering of the cream; assembly of the elite

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, parisāmaṇḍo? idha, bhikkhave, yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū na chand'āgatiṃ gacchanti, na dos'āgatiṃ gacchanti, na moh'āgatiṃ gacchanti, na bhay'āgatiṃ gacchanti.

44118.meaning1: who is familiar with assemblies; who moves around society
44118.commentary: (SNa) paris'āvacaro'ti parisāya avacaro. parisaṃ nāma bālā'pi, paṇḍitā'pi osaranti, yo pana parappavādaṃ madditvā attano vādaṃ dīpetuṃ sakkoti, ayaṃ paris'āvacaro nāma.

examples.text: yato ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti, sīlavā ca, bahussuto ca, dhammakathiko ca, paris'āvacaro ca, visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti… evaṃ so ten'aṅgena paripūro hoti.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati tap'od'ārāme. atha kho āyasmā samiddhi rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena tap'odā ten'upasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
atha kho bhagavā sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, āyām'ānanda, yena pubbakoṭṭhako ten'upasaṅkamissāma gattāni parisiñcitun'ti.
tap'ode gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubb'āpayamāno.
atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbakoṭṭhako ten'upasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ. pubbakoṭṭhake gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubb'āpayamāno.
kati jāgarataṃ suttā, kati suttesu jāgarā, katīhi rajaṃ ādeti, katīhi parisujjhatī'ti.

44133.synonym: asaṃkiliṭṭha, pasanna, pāvaka, visada, vītaraja, saṃsuddha, sukka, suci, sucibhūta, sucīmant, suddha, suddhika

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte acche vā udakapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno
vippasannāni kho te, gahapati, indriyāni, parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, vatthaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ malaggahitaṃ acch'odakaṃ āgamma parisuddhaṃ hoti pariyodātaṃ, ukkāmukhaṃ vā pan'āgamma jātarūpaṃ parisuddhaṃ hoti pariyodātaṃ.

44135.meaning1: discussion about reaching the pure peak and heartwood
44135.sanskrit: pariśuddha + agra + prāpta + sāra + prāpta + kathā

44137.meaning1: fact of being pure in bodily action; fact of being undefiled in physical conduct

examples.text: etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, parisuddhakāyakammataṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.

44138.meaning1: who is pure in bodily action; undefiled in physical conduct

examples.text: na kho pan'āhaṃ aparisuddhakāyakamm'anto araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevāmi, parisuddhakāyakamm'anto'ham'asmi.
idha pan'āvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro hoti parisuddhakāyasamācāro. evarūpe'pi, āvuso, puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo
ye'pi te, sāḷha, samaṇabrāhmaṇā parisuddhakāyasamācārā parisuddhavacīsamācārā parisuddhamanosamācārā parisuddh'ājīvā, bhabbā te ñāṇadassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.

44140.meaning1: purity of physical action; fact of having clean bodily conduct
44140.construction:
parisuddha + kāya + samācāra + tā
parisuddhakāyasamācāra + tā

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, āvuso, yv'āyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro parisuddhakāyasamācāro, y'āssa aparisuddhavacīsamācāratā na s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā, yā ca khv'āssa parisuddhakāyasamācāratā s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā.

parisuddho no kāyasamācāro bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca. tāya ca pana parisuddhakāyasamācāratāya n'ev'attān'ukkaṃsessāma na paraṃ vambhessāmā'ti evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.

44141.meaning1: pure in understanding and insight; with perfect knowledge and vision

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, moggallāna, idh'ekacco satthā aparisuddhañāṇadassano samāno parisuddhañāṇadassano'mhī'ti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me ñāṇadassanaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan'ti.

44142.meaning1: discussion about reaching the pure inner bark

examples.text: tam'enaṃ sāmikā paribhuñjeyyuñ'c'eva pariyodapeyyuñ'ca, na ca naṃ raj'āpathe nikkhipeyyuṃ. evañ'hi sā, āvuso, kaṃsapāti aparena samayena parisuddhatarā assa pariyodātā'ti? evam'āvuso'ti.
taṃ kissa hetu? parisuddhattā, bhikkhave, vatthassa. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, citte asaṃkiliṭṭhe, sugati pāṭikaṅkhā.

44145.meaning1: preaching a pure teaching; teaching perfect Dhamma

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, moggallāna, idh'ekacco satthā aparisuddhadhammadesano samāno parisuddhadhammadesano'mhī'ti paṭijānāti parisuddhā me dhammadesanā pariyodātā asaṃkiliṭṭhā'ti.
garuke mama satthusāsane, yā sikkhā sugatena desitā, parisuddhapadaṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ, kiṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi.

44147.meaning1: discussion about reaching the pure dry outer bark

44148.meaning1: discussion about reaching the pure sapwood

examples.text: ye'pi te, sāḷha, samaṇabrāhmaṇā parisuddhakāyasamācārā parisuddhavacīsamācārā parisuddhamanosamācārā parisuddh'ājīvā, bhabbā te ñāṇadassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.

44150.meaning1: purity of mental conduct; fact of being pure in thought
44150.construction:
parisuddha + mano + samācāra + tā
parisuddhamanosamācāra + tā

examples.text: parisuddho no manosamācāro bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca. tāya ca pana parisuddhamanosamācāratāya n'ev'attān'ukkaṃsessāma na paraṃ vambhessāmā'ti evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.

44151.meaning1: who has purified all the doors; i.e. body, speech and mind

44152.meaning1: with clean morals; having pure conduct

examples.text: ahaṃ kho pana, moggallāna, parisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlo'mhī'ti paṭijānāmi parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan'ti. na ca maṃ sāvakā sīlato rakkhanti, na c'āhaṃ sāvakehi sīlato rakkhaṃ paccāsīsāmi.

evam'evā'ti etthā'pi idaṃ opammasaṃsandanaṃ, sālalaṭṭhi viya attabhāvo, nadīsotaṃ viya saṃsārasotaṃ, pāraṃ gantu'kāmapuriso viya yog'āvacaro, bahiddhā suparikammakatakālo viya chasu dvāresu saṃvarassa paccupaṭṭhitakālo, anto suvisodhitabhāvo viya abbhantare parisuddhasīlabhāvo, phiy'ārittabandhanaṃ viya kāyikacetasika-vīriya-karaṇaṃ, sotthinā pārimatīragamanaṃ viya anupubbena sīlaṃ pūretvā samādhiṃ pūretvā paññaṃ pūretvā nibbānagamanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

44155.meaning1: with purified verbal conduct; with clean speech

examples.text: pañc'ime, āvuso, āghātapaṭivinayā yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo. katame pañca? idh'āvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhavacīsamācāro.
ye'pi te, sāḷha, samaṇabrāhmaṇā parisuddhakāyasamācārā parisuddhavacīsamācārā parisuddhamanosamācārā parisuddh'ājīvā, bhabbā te ñāṇadassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.

44156.meaning1: purity of verbal conduct; fact of being pure in verbal conduct
44156.construction:
parisuddha + vacī + samācāra + tā
parisuddhavacīsamācāra + tā

examples.text: evam'evaṃ khv'āvuso, yv'āyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro, y'āssa aparisuddhakāyasamācāratā na s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā, yā ca khv'āssa parisuddhavacīsamācāratā s'āssa tasmiṃ samaye manasi kātabbā.

parisuddho no vacīsamācāro bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca. tāya ca pana parisuddhavacīsamācāratāya n'ev'attān'ukkaṃsessāma na paraṃ vambhessāmā'ti evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.
tam'enaṃ rajako yasmiṃ yasmiṃ raṅgajāte upasaṃhareyya, yadi nīlakāya yadi pītakāya yadi lohitakāya yadi mañjiṭṭhakāya, surattavaṇṇam'ev'assa parisuddhavaṇṇam'ev'assa.

44158.meaning1: with a pure explanation; with a perfect exposition

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, moggallāna, idh'ekacco satthā aparisuddhaveyyākaraṇo samāno parisuddhaveyyākaraṇo'mhī'ti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me veyyākaraṇaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan'ti.

44159.meaning1: pure in way of talking; perfect in mode of communication; pure in verbal dealings

examples.text: vokkamati ayam'āyasmā purimavohārā pacchimavohāraṃ, aparisuddhavohāro ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā parisuddhavohāro'ti.

44160.meaning1: with pure livelihood; with proper mode of living

examples.text: ye'pi te, sāḷha, samaṇabrāhmaṇā parisuddhakāyasamācārā parisuddhavacīsamācārā parisuddhamanosamācārā parisuddh'ājīvā, bhabbā te ñāṇadassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
na kho pan'āhaṃ aparisuddhājīvo araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevāmi, parisuddhājīvo'ham'asmi.

44161.meaning1: fact of having a pure livelihood; fact of having a proper mode of living

examples.text: etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, parisuddh'ājīvataṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.
parisuddho no ājīvo bhavissati uttāno vivaṭo na ca chiddavā saṃvuto ca. tāya ca pana parisuddh'ājīvatāya n'ev'attān'ukkaṃsessāma na paraṃ vambhessāmā'ti evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.

idha pana, gahapati, ekacco parisuddh'ābhā'ti pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parisuddh'ābhānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati. imā kho, gahapati, catasso bhav'ūpapattiyo.
chandaparisuddhi, utu'kkhānaṃ, bhikkhugaṇanā ca, ovādo, uposathassa etāni, pubbakiccan'ti vuccati.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: mā brāhmaṇa dāru samādahāno, suddhiṃ amaññi bahiddhā hi etaṃ, na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti, yo bāhirena parisuddhim'icche.

44165.meaning1: the venerables are pure in this regard

examples.text: tatth'āyasmante pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā, dutiyam'pi pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā, tatiyam'pi pucchāmi, kacci'ttha parisuddhā, parisuddh'etth'āyasmanto, tasmā tuṇhī, evam'etaṃ dhārayāmī'ti.

44166.meaning1: dries up; withers up; shrivels up

examples.text: phuṭṭhassa me aññatarena byādhinā, rogena bāḷhaṃ dukhitassa ruppato, parisussati khippam'idaṃ kaḷevaraṃ, pupphaṃ yathā paṃsuni ātape kataṃ.

44169.meaning2: having dried up, having washed away

44171.commentary: (SNa) sammā pariseditānī'ti kālena kālaṃ utuṃ gaṇhāpentiyā suṭṭhu samantato seditāni usmīkatāni.

examples.text: tān'assu kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni sammā pariseditāni sammā paribhāvitāni

katamo ca, bhikkhave, soko? yo kho, bhikkhave, aññatar'aññatarena byasanena samannāgatassa aññatar'aññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa soko socanā socitattaṃ antosoko antoparisoko, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, soko

44177.synonym: punāti, visodhayati, visodheti, vodāpeti, sodhayati, sodheti
44177.commentary: (ANa) abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodhetī'ti abhijjhāto cittaṃ parimoceti, yathā naṃ sā muñcati c'eva muñcitvā ca na puna gaṇhāti, evaṃ karotī'ti attho.

examples.text: divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhessāma
ye'pi hi keci, rāhula, anāgatam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyakammaṃ parisodhessanti… sabbe te evam'evaṃ paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā kāyakammaṃ parisodhessanti
ye hi keci, rāhula, atītam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyakammaṃ parisodhesuṃ… sabbe te evam'evaṃ paccavekkhitvā paccavekkhitvā kāyakammaṃ parisodhesuṃ
so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigat'ābhijjhena cetasā vihāsiṃ, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ.
amanussaṭṭhāne udakaṃ'va sītaṃ, tadapeyyamānaṃ parisosam'eti, evaṃ dhanaṃ kāpuriso labhitvā, n'ev'attanā bhuñjati no dadāti.

44184.meaning1: making dry up; causing to evaporate

examples.text: akālacāriñ'hi sajanti saṅgā, akālacāriṃ puggalaṃ rāgasaṅg'ādayo aneke saṅgā sajanti parissajanti upaguhanti allīyanti. tasmā vikāle na caranti buddhā, tasmā ye catusaccabuddhā ariyapuggalā, na te vikāle piṇḍāya carantī'ti.
kilanto'smī'ti parissanto asmi. tena yathāvuttavedanānaṃ balavabhāvaṃ eva dasseti.
sace labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ, saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāridhīraṃ, abhibhuyya sabbāni parissayāni, careyya ten'attamano satīmā.
abalā naṃ balīyanti, maddant'enaṃ parissayā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, nāvaṃ bhinnam'iv'odakaṃ.

paṭisaṅkhā yoniso sen'āsanaṃ paṭisevāmi yāva'd'eva sītassa paṭighātāya uṇhassa paṭighātāya ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-siriṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya yāva'd'eva utuparissayavinodanaṃ paṭisallān'ārām'atthaṃ

44197.commentary: (PYt) udakaṃ parisuddhaṃ hutvā savati gacchati pavattati anenā'ti parissāvanaṃ.

examples.text: parisā c'assa hoti bāhullikā. laddhaṃ laddhaṃ kolambe'pi ghaṭe'pi pūretvā paṭisāmeti, parissāvanāni'pi thavikāyo'pi pūretvā vātapānesu laggeti. tāni olīnavilīnāni tiṭṭhanti.
so hi khuddakavāsiñ'ca sūciñ'ca parissāvane pakkhipitvā pattassa anto ṭhapetvā pattaṃ aṃsakūṭe laggetvā ticīvaraṃ kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ katvā yen'icchakaṃ sukhaṃ pakkamati.
